name: Haus Gertraud
beschreibung:
Situated in the idyllic mountaineering village of Schmirn, Haus Gertraud welcomes nature and hiking enthusiasts with cosy rooms and genuine Tyrolean warmth. It provides a peaceful retreat far from crowded resorts.

Mount Olperer, alpine circuit trails, and untouched ski touring slopes start right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Gertraud in Schmirn offers pristine tranquility in an authentic Wipptal mountaineering village.
